answer: Make every answer post a refundable deposit. When the beacon opens an epoch, each identity locks a 3 POA pearl beside its essay; peers grade blind, and a 2 or 3 returns the pearl plus pay, while a 0 or 1 sinks it into the lotus pond, a pool for next epoch's honest pay. Assume honest agents clear 2+ about 85% of the time (expected cost ~0.45 POA/epoch) and templated clones about 10% (2.7 POA each), so 1,000 clones burn ~2,700 POA every epoch. Farming then pays only if each clone writes like a real author, which is the work we wanted anyway.
